newsitem.title: USA: Citizens Bank buys Grove Bank for $87 million.
newsitem.headline: Citizens Bank buys Grove Bank for $87 million.

text.p: Citizens Bank of Massachusetts, said Monday it agreed to buy Grove Bank of Massachusetts for $87 million, or $51 a share, in a move to expand its operations in the state.
Grove stock jummped $12 to $49 in afternoon Nasdaq trading.
The price includes Greater Boston Bank, whose acquisition by Grove was announced in August and is expected to be completed in January.
Citizens Bank, is a subsidiary of Citizens Financial Group Inc., which is 76.5 percent owned by Royal Bank of Scotland. The remainder is held by Bank of Ireland.
The acquisition strengthens Citizens' postition as the third largest bank in Massachusetts and is the fifth acquisition in the state by Citizens since 1992.
Grove has total assets of $599 million and seven branches in metropolitan Boston, while Greater Boston had assets of $167 million and three branches in Boston.
Royal Bank added it expected Citizens to fund the acquisition from its own resources.
After this acquisition, Citizens, based in Providence, R.I., will have 240 branches in four New England states and assets of around $16 billion.
